subject: [PATCH v9 03/32] loongarch: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch adds helpers to manage PMD-mapped anonymous huge pages (THPs) that are exclusive to swap on the LoongArch architecture. The goal is to keep these THPs mapped across a swap round-trip, which requires modifying the behavior of the PG_anon_exclusive flag in the presence of swap PMDs. The patch introduces new helpers for setting and clearing the _PAGE_SWP_EXCLUSIVE bit in PMD values.
